findings.detail: «Мы — правильно» is an unnatural Russian calque of «We were right», weakening the narrator's sense that being together felt right. Preserve the simple assertion without an ungrammatical predicate.

source_anchor.quote: This was right. We were right.

findings.detail: «Издавал едва слышные звуки мне в губы» is an awkward circumlocution for «little whimpers and groans in my mouth» and partly loses the two types of sounds. Convey them in idiomatic Russian without adding intensity.

source_anchor.quote: He gave me little whimpers and groans in my mouth.

translation_anchor.quote: Он тихонько постанывал и издавал едва слышные звуки мне в губы.
